Header: Didymella bryoniae ( Stagonosporopsis cucurbitacearum ) Tormoger ros jhora rog

Prevention: Follow crop rotation with non- cucurbit crops (such as maize and sorghum) every 2 years.
Soil amendment with poultry refuse @ 6-8 kg/pit 15 days before seed sowing.
Monitoring: Inspect the water melon field at least twice a week during the growing season.
Early symptoms are round water-soaked lesions, wrinkled spots on young leaves and dark sunken areas on stems.
Stem cankers develop in the infected plant.
Gummy red exudation may be seen from infected stems.
Consider direct control actions as soon as disease symptoms are identified in the field.
Direct Control: Remove infected plant parts from the field and burn to destroy.
Rouging of infected plants at early stages.
Bordeaux paste (1:1:10) on the stem up to one foot from the soil at the early stage.
Restrictions: Wear protective clothing such as gloves, goggles, apron, etc. during the spraying and handling of fungicides.
Avoid drinking, eating and smoking while mixing and spraying fungicides.
M-45 at a rate of 2 g/ litre water) 3 times with 12 days interval.
U, unlikely to present acute hazard in normal use.
Sunvit 2 g/litre water) 3 times with 12 days interval.
